abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.rawDescription:
Each round: 20% chance to apply Vulnerable to 1 enemy within adjacency for 2 rounds. Vulnerable increases Damage Received by +10%.

Rounds 3, 6, and 9: deal Fire Damage to 2 enemies within adjacency at a +65% Damage Rate. Fire Damage is increased by the attacker's Intelligence and mitigated by the target's Initiative.

At 6+ Stars, Fiery Precision augments Relentless Pursuit. Each round, also deal Fire Damage to 3 enemies in any lane afflicted with Slow. The Damage Rate uses Fiery Precision's current Habit Level: +20% / +24% / +28% / +34% / +40%. This added Slow-conditioned attack is additive to the base Command and is represented once.

abilities.name: Hunter's Wrath
abilities.rawDescription: At Dragon Level 16+ while Antares is deployed in Vanguard: increase Antares Fire Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Strength of the Right Flank ally by +20 and Initiative of the Right Flank ally by +20.

abilities.name: Blazing Onslaught
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Round 1 for 3 rounds: increase Fire Damage Received of 1 enemy in any lane, prioritizing Left Flank. Separately increase non-Basic-Attack Physical Damage Received of 1 enemy in any lane, prioritizing Right Flank. The target selections are independent; distinctness is not stated, so the same target is allowed but not required. This direct typed Damage Received amplification is not the named Vulnerable status.

Progression table (Fire and non-Basic Physical Damage Received increase):
Habit Level 1: +11%
Habit Level 2: +13.2%
Habit Level 3: +15.4%
Habit Level 4: +18.7%
Habit Level 5: +22%

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Redemption
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of combat until end of combat: increase Antares Intelligence and Initiative. Start of each round: make one activation roll; on success, grant Antares immunity to both Vulnerable and Weakened for 2 rounds. The two immunities share one successful roll, not two independent rolls. The screenshot does not confirm cleansing an already active status, refresh behavior, or stacking behavior. Self-only.

Progression table (Intelligence and Initiative; immunity chance):
Habit Level 1: +6%; 10%
Habit Level 2: +7.8%; 13%
Habit Level 3: +9.6%; 16%
Habit Level 4: +12%; 20%
Habit Level 5: +15%; 25%

Power: 250 / 580 / 1000 / 1600 / 2300
